description: The response for a grid record set export request.

sessionId.description: The session ID of the exported grid.

recordSetId.description: The id of the record set entity where the grid data was exported to.

recordSetVersionNumber.description: The version number of the record set entity where the grid data was exported to.

validationFileHandleId.description: The id of the file handle that points to a CSV file containing detailed validation results for each row exported from the grid.
